verdict.rationale: Quo ships a built-in AI agent, Sona, that the business delegates call answering to: it answers when the team can't, captures details, and hands off to humans. Built-in AI also transcribes and summarizes calls and applies AI call tags. The MCP server and Claude/ChatGPT connectors are external agents, not a built-in assistant, so they earn no credit here. Missing for 10: a general-purpose in-product assistant that accepts arbitrary user-delegated tasks, documentation of Sona's configuration and task scope, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Sona answers when your team can't, captures the details you need, and hands the conversation to your team when it matters.
Recorded calls come back transcribed and summarized, so no detail is missed and nobody has to take notes.
